visual.criterion: Camera preview, capture control and Gallery affordance match an approved Camera page visual at 360/393/412/480dp.
visual.method: Compare implementation to the registered Camera page visual and Layout Contract.
visual.pass_condition: Every declared viewport matches the authority; no Processing keyframe is used as the camera screen.

visual.criterion: BG_CAPTURE shows an opaque current-user image with the registered camera crop behavior and no Morning Lake underlay.
visual.method: Inspect media source and rendered bounds against Background Registry.
visual.pass_condition: Source image is the current capture/selection, no tint or lake underlay, crop follows a registered page contract.

interaction.criterion: With permission and provider ready, one capture produces one normalized image and enters Processing.
interaction.method: Drive the capture state machine with a ready provider and readable result.
interaction.pass_condition: Exactly one normalized image handoff; no record persistence occurs.

interaction.criterion: Gallery cancellation leaves the capture attempt unchanged; readable selection follows the same normalized-image handoff.
interaction.method: Open Picker, cancel, then repeat with a readable image.
interaction.pass_condition: Cancellation remains recoverable and non-mutating; valid image enters Processing.

interaction.criterion: Permission denial/provider unavailability never starts capture and exposes an approved recovery path.
interaction.pass_condition: No preview/capture action runs without its guard; recovery does not persist a record.

accessibility.criterion: Every actionable control reaches the registered 44×44dp minimum target and has an accessible name/state.
accessibility.method: Measure target bounds and inspect accessibility semantics at registered widths and fontScale.
accessibility.pass_condition: Target is at least touch.minimum and its action/state is exposed once.

accessibility.criterion: Large system font scale does not hide the Gallery or recovery path.
accessibility.method: Inspect at the Geometry System fontScale acceptance levels after a camera visual is registered.
accessibility.pass_condition: All actions remain reachable without unapproved truncation.

error.criterion: Permission denial, provider failure, capture failure, picker cancellation and unreadable image remain distinguishable and recoverable.
error.pass_condition: No failure silently enters Processing or creates a record.

error.criterion: Permission or media failure recovery copy and visual matches an approved Camera authority.
error.method: Compare each failure state to its page visual and copy authority.
error.pass_condition: No invented copy or control is present.
